chunks: "A single hajj (pilgrimage) is better than freeing seventy slaves."

key_terms.رَقَبَةً: a slave person to be emancipated

ai.seo_question: How great is the reward and virtue of performing one hajj?
ai.summary: This narration emphasizes the immense virtue and reward of performing hajj. It presents one hajj as surpassing even a very great act of charity and liberation, highlighting the lofty spiritual rank of this act of worship.
